title: Supplemental materials for "Evaluating Open-Weight Large Language Models for Structured Depression Assessment from Clinical Interviews"
description:
Analysis code (Quarto source files) and rendered analysis reports supporting the article "Evaluating Open-Weight Large Language Models for Structured Depression Assessment from Clinical Interviews" (Journal of Psychopathology and Clinical Science). Reports cover model benchmarking, a psychometric fairness audit, a prompt ablation study, and a cross-model ensemble comparison.

Source code is licensed under the MIT License; rendered reports and other non-code content are licensed under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE and LICENSE-CC-BY.md in the archive). The interview recordings and transcripts analyzed in the study contain protected health information and are not included.
